resources.string: Personal-use tool: copies YOUR OWN WhatsApp backup files to YOUR server. Keep it on your own devices only.
How to create the WhatsApp backup
Rooted: also copy live msgstore.db (needs root)
Auto mode (no server): collect chats to Documents/wa-auto, pull to PC over USB
No WhatsApp backup found yet. Open WhatsApp → Settings → Chats → Chat backup → Back Up, then press “Backup now” here.

Step 1: On the phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Chats → Chat backup → tap “Back Up” (choose “On device”, Google Drive OFF is fine). Step 2: Grant this app all-files access (or pick the WhatsApp folder) so it can read Android/media/com.whatsapp/…/.Backups/msgstore-*.crypt14. Step 3: Press “Backup now”. The .crypt14 file stays encrypted by WhatsApp AND is additionally AES-encrypted before upload — only you with the token+passphrase can decrypt it.
